facts.statement: The genus Khulsanurus was described by Averianov and Lopatin in 2022.
Khulsanurus lived in the Late Cretaceous in the Gobi Desert region of Mongolia.
facts.quote: from the Late Cretaceous Baruungoyot Formation of the Khulsan Locality in the Gobi Desert region of Mongolia

facts.statement: The name Khulsanurus means "tail from Khulsan".
The known fossil material includes neck and tail vertebrae, shoulder bones, and leg bones.
facts.quote: Khulsanurus is known from a holotype containing partial vertebral series of the neck and tail, scapulocoracoids, a right humerus, a possible left humerus, and a left pubis

facts.statement: The neck vertebrae of Khulsanurus lack pleurocoels, carotid processes, and epipophyses.
facts.quote: Distinguishing autapomorphies of this specimen include pleurocoel-, carotid process-, and epipophysis-less cervical vertebrae

facts.statement: The tail vertebrae have a prominent fossa and prezygapophyses that point forward.
facts.quote: prominent infrapostzygapophyseal fossa of the caudal vertebrae which also bear anteriorly pointing prezygapophyses

facts.statement: Khulsanurus is classified as an alvarezsaurid theropod dinosaur.
facts.quote: is an extinct genus of alvarezsaurid theropod dinosaur

facts.statement: Khulsanurus belongs to the subfamily Parvicursorinae.
Khulsanurus lived between 83.6 and 72.2 million years ago during the Campanian stage.
facts.quote: Time range: Campanian to Campanian (83.6 to 72.2 million years ago)

facts.statement: Fossils of Khulsanurus were found in the Campanian Barun Goyot Formation.
facts.quote: Khulsanurus was found in the Campanian Barun Goyot Formation

facts.statement: Khulsanurus shared its environment with mammals like Catopsbaatar and Nemegtbaatar.
facts.quote: which was also home to many other animals, including mammals such as Catopsbaatar and Nemegtbaatar

facts.statement: Contemporary dinosaurs included ornithischians such as Saichania, Tarchia, and Bagaceratops.
facts.quote: and numerous dinosaurs, including ornithischians such as Saichania, Tarchia, Zaraapelta, Tylocephale, Bagaceratops, Breviceratops, and Udanoceratops

facts.statement: The ecosystem included the sauropod dinosaur Quaesitosaurus.
Other theropods living alongside Khulsanurus included Conchoraptor, Parvicursor, and Ceratonykus.
facts.quote: and theropods, including Conchoraptor, Heyuannia, Nemegtomaia, Hulsanpes, Kuru, Shri devi, Ceratonykus, Ondogurvel, Parvicursor, Gobipteryx, and Hollanda

facts.statement: It is debated how Khulsanurus is related to other alvarezsaurids, with some analyses placing it in a polytomy with genera like Albinykus and Parvicursor.
facts.quote: Averianov & Lopatin (2021) placed Khulsanurus in a polytomy with Albinykus, Ceratonykus, Linhenykus, Parvicursor, Xixianykus, Qiupanykus, Nemegtonykus, PIN 5838/1 (=Ondogurvel) and a clade containing Shuvuuia and Mononykus
